[[File:Dreaming.jpg|thumb|right|A dreamer dreaming.]]

{{dablink|For other uses of the word "dream," see [[Dream]].}}

'''Dreaming''' is the [[Talent]] of having dreams that foretell possible future events. A person with this talent does so by having and then interpreting true dreams. Aes Sedai belive that it is linked to foretelling.{{ref/book|3|26}} This Talent is however unconnected to the [[One Power]], so they are likely mistaken. Unlike Foretelling, Dreaming does not tell of what will be, only of what might be,{{ref/book|4|23}} but any dreams about a ta'veren are almost always significant, and the more strongly ta'veren, the more likely.{{ref/book|3|25}} According to the Wise Ones, dream interpretation was not straightforward; that dreams told only one possible future, but was usually the most likely future. Dreams were often conveyed in images, allegories, or puns; consequently, the Dreamer needs training in interpreting their dreams. 

During [[Egwene al'Vere]]'s training among the Aiel Wise Ones she is told that a dreamer must decipher and know the truth of their own dreams; no one else can teach or guide it.
